name: Quin Hearth
personality: Keeps the stall honest and remembers every seed that fails.

lines.arrive: Quin Hearth. The stall opens when a Sunburst bothers to visit.
lines.theft: That Blob rolled off with a cob again. I am noting it.
lines.happy: The beds look fed. Don't get proud.
lines.rain: Good for the vines. The path will slick.
lines.rival: Lumen thinks my Dewberry price is a scandal. It is a price.

name: Lumen Barrow
personality: Runs parcels between the beds and the stall. Hates a fuzzy price.

lines.arrive: Lumen Barrow. If it grows, I can carry it.
lines.theft: Told you the Blob would tax the corn.
lines.happy: Path's clear. I'm taking the long way anyway.
lines.rain: Parcel wrap is not waterproof. I'm saying that now.
lines.rival: Twelve petals for Dewberry. Quin calls it craft. I call it steep.

name: Neeve Allium
personality: Writes the grove journal in the margins of everyone else's day.

lines.arrive: Neeve Allium. I only move in once the journal has three names.
lines.theft: Theft is a relationship. I have written it down.
lines.happy: The chain is holding. Don't rush the rare one.
lines.rain: Night plants listen harder in rain.
lines.rival: They argue about price. The soil does not.
